Definition: from G2507; demolition; figuratively, extinction:--destruction, pulling down.
BiblicalUsage: Destruction is the pulling down, and Paul says our weapons are mighty to the pulling down of strong holds, and his authority was given for edification and not for destruction, and he writes sharply so he will not have to use sharpness when he comes. The word is the power to tear down, and Paul insists it was given to build up instead. Authority that destroys is authority misused.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe authority is given to build, not to destroy, and the apostle who could tear down chose to build up. I hold that the sharpest letter is the kind one, because it warns before it wounds, and I want my words to do the same.
